description: Erection of a part single, part two storey side extension and a single storey rear infill extension to the house, re-provision of a front main entrance door and addition of a second first floor front window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (21025-1000 (Rev 05); 21025-2001 (Rev 04)  Received:  11 October 2022;  21025-1001 (Rev 04); 21025-2002 (Rev 04)  Received:  10 October 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the part single, part two storey side extension and single storey rear infill extension hereby approved.
